Trace, implement and test: leetcode300 longest increasing subsequence binary search and greedy

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int lengthOfLIS(vector<int>& nums) {
        int n = nums.size();
        vector<int> dp(n, 1); /* dp[i]: 以 nums[i] 结尾的LIS(最长上升子序列)的长度  */
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            {
                if (nums[j] < nums[i]) /* 新来的数nums[j]是否能形成1个新的LIS, 使得nums[j]是新LIS中第2大的数且新LIS长度=LIS的长度+1? 如果能就更新之 */
                    dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            }
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            res = max(res, dp[i]); 
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {10, 9, 2, 5, 3, 7};
    auto res = sol.lengthOfLIS(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
